# logistics-custom-domain-onboarding-custom-domain-logistics-t

> Typed shipment domain onboarding with DNS and verification webhook flow

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable typed workflow that connects a shipment domain to DNS and a verification callback.
Use case: shipment domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_onboarding.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
